label: FAKE: hand-written demo data, not real model output
purpose: Demo test cases, one per criterion.

test_cases.title: Submit a complete request
preconditions: Nurse is logged in on a ward PC
test_cases.expected_result: The request is saved and a reference number is shown.

test_cases.title: Attach a photo
test_cases.expected_result: The photo is stored with the request.

test_cases.title: Missing required field
test_cases.expected_result: The request is not saved and the location field is marked as missing.

test_cases.title: Life-support request gets top priority
preconditions: A device is classified as life-support
steps: Submit a request for that device
test_cases.expected_result: The request has the highest priority.

test_cases.title: Imaging request goes to imaging
steps: Submit a request for an imaging device
test_cases.expected_result: The request appears in the imaging team's queue.

test_cases.title: Overview shows open requests per team
preconditions: Open requests exist for two teams
test_cases.expected_result: The number of open requests per team and the age of each request are shown.

test_cases.title: Sign in with hospital login
steps: Sign in with the hospital account
test_cases.expected_result: The user is signed in and no separate password is asked for.

test_cases.title: Monthly report delivered
test_cases.expected_result: The head of biomedical engineering receives it.
